content.html:
• Closed the long weekend and opened the short week with a reunion lunch in Nakame including references to Se7ven and what we suspect was Froyo, before heading to see band club play live. They were pretty great!
  • Remember to bring hearing protection lxds.
  • Leant on some of my CliftonStrengths™ mid-week to pull a plan out of many loose strands for a new assignment. That was particularly enjoyable.
  • Meetings are getting easier to follow, but are still incredibly hard. This is to say that grammar study is paying off, but I totally freeze up when asked questions in Japanese.
  • Got some good but hard feedback about an initiative.
  • On Friday we consumed many lemons and sang many songs.
  • Reading speed is a limiting factor in karaoke, and mine is particularly slow.
  • Oh yeah, I have a new textbook! Still bricking it.
  • At the weekend we started in a cabaret club and ended up doing beyblade matches. My rental let win a lot, but I think that I also accidentally found a good strategy? I also learned that I’m awful at posing when I’m thinking about it: Something about being self-conscious.
  • New hair-cut is, eh, OK? Record time though.
  • Gave a tour of the Daimon/Azabudai/Toranomon area, and that was fun: We hit up Tokyo tower (my first time since 2018) and a nearby not-so-secret museum. Unfortunately Fuji was hiding.
  • October has been surprisingly busy, but not in the way I’d hoped. Anyway, back to reviews.
